en: A black‑and‑white historic postcard showing a small railway station building labeled "STANGE" beside train tracks. A train with a locomotive and cars stands on the right track, while wooden planking covers the platform area in the foreground. The station building is two stories with gabled roof and multiple windows, and people can be seen near the entrance. The text at the top left reads "Stationen, Stange."
